name: Ba Chua Xu Temple
nameVi: Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ Núi Sam
kicker: Pilgrimage hall at the foot of Núi Sam
summary: Pilgrimage hall at Núi Sam: stand on the offering steps and see the statue before the festival crowds. People bring whole pigs, roast chickens, fruit, rice cakes, and pink lotus. The statue is said to have been found on the mountain about 200 years ago, and the present hall began in the early 19th century as a bamboo-and-leaf shrine. In the fourth lunar month, come at the start of the day.
getThere: Same road as Sam Mountain, about 5 km or about 7 km from town.
heroCaption: The green-roofed hall of Miếu Bà Chúa Xứ at the foot of Núi Sam

notice.title: Come early in the fourth lunar month
notice.body: The heaviest days run from the first lunar month through the Via festival. UNESCO dates the festival to the 22nd–27th of the fourth lunar month. The rural tourism page dates it to the 23rd–27th. Arrive early, or come outside that window.

body: Stand on the steps and watch what people bring: whole pigs, roast chickens, fruit, rice cakes, and pink lotus, with incense in front of the statue inside. The statue is said to have been found on the mountain about 200 years ago. The present hall sits at the foot of Núi Sam. It began in the early 19th century as a bamboo-and-leaf shrine and was later rebuilt with curved southern roofs.
This is the heart of the national tourism area, and the place the 2026 festival opened. On an ordinary morning the visit is the hall and the steps, then Tây An and the tomb.
The shrine is in phường Vĩnh Tế, at the mountain. A gate fee is not printed on the UNESCO page or the 2026 culture-department article.

figures.caption: The tiled eaves and red panels of the same hall

gettingThere: The temple is at the foot of Núi Sam, in phường Vĩnh Tế. Use the same road as the rest of the hill. An older national-tourism article prints both about 5 km and about 7 km from the city. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the Châu Đốc river
legs.body: By road, with the rest of the Sam Mountain cluster. The printed distances disagree: about 5 km and about 7 km. Minutes are check on arrival.
